safer-fmcsa-dot-gov.title: FMCSA SAFER and SMS carrier registry

post.description:
You have a USDOT or MC/MX number (from search_carriers, search_sms_carriers or elsewhere) and need the carrier's registration, fleet and safety summary.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

mc_mx_number.description: MC or MX docket number, digits with an optional MC-/MX- prefix (`MC-138328` or `138328`). One of usdot_number or mc_mx_number.

usdot_number.description: USDOT number (digits), or a SAFER query.asp / SMS /SMS/Carrier/{dot}/ URL. One of usdot_number or mc_mx_number.

authorized_for: Motor Carrier of Property (Except Household Goods)

200.description:
SAFER Company Snapshot (query.asp) for one carrier by USDOT number or MC/MX docket number: entity type, USDOT and operating authority status, out-of-service date, MCS-150 form date and mileage, docket numbers, legal/DBA names, addresses, phone, DUNS, power units, non-CMV units, drivers, operation classification, carrier operation, cargo carried, US and Canadian 24-month inspection/out-of-service/crash counts with national OOS averages, the federal safety rating, and the system's as-of date. `usdot_number` also accepts a pasted SAFER query.asp or SMS carrier URL.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description:
You have a USDOT number and need the SMS safety performance view (BASICs, investigations, inspection and crash breakdown) rather than SAFER's registration snapshot.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

usdot_number.description: USDOT number (digits) or an SMS /SMS/Carrier/{dot}/ URL.

200.description:
SMS carrier overview (ai.fmcsa.dot.gov/SMS/Carrier/{dot}/Overview.aspx): legal name, address, number of vehicles, drivers and inspections, the 24-month record end date, the seven BASICs with their public/not-public flag and detail URLs, the five most recent investigations, inspection totals with and without violations, driver/vehicle/hazmat inspection counts with out-of-service rates, fatal/injury/tow-away crash counts, registration flags and the enforcement-cases note. `usdot_number` also accepts a pasted SMS carrier URL.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `activities_as_of` | string |  |
| `address` | string |  |
| `address_lines` | string[] |  |
| `basics` | object[] |  |
| `complete_profile_url` | string |  |
| `crash_summary` | object | Keyed by the activity summary's row label (fatal_crashes, injury_crashes, towaway_crashes): {count}. |
| `download_url` | string |  |
| `drivers` | number |  |
| `enforcement_cases` | string | The Enforcement Cases panel text (`No penalties found` or the cases shown). |
| `enforcement_cases_as_of` | string |  |
| `inspection_summary` | object | Keyed by the activity summary's row label (driver_inspections, vehicle_inspections, placardable_hm_inspections, pct_placardable_hm_inspections ...): {count, out_of_service_pct} or {pct}. |
| `inspections` | number |  |
| `inspections_with_violations` | number |  |
| `inspections_without_violations` | number |  |
| `investigations` | object[] | Up to the five most recent investigations. |
| `legal_name` | string |  |
| `most_recent_investigation` | object |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `record_end_date` | string | ISO date ending the 24-month SMS record (monthly snapshot). |
| `registration_flags` | string[] |  |
| `snapshot_url` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_crashes` | number |  |
| `total_inspections` | number |  |
| `usdot_number` | string |  |
| `vehicles` | number |  |

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

basic.description:
Restrict the export to one BASIC (the site's Download focus). Default all. crash_indicator exports crashes only.

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "unsafe_driving", "hos_compliance", "driver_fitness", "drugs_alcohol", "vehicle_maintenance", "hm_compliance", "crash_indicator"].

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's meta.page.next_cursor (the record offset); omit for the first page.

usdot_number.description: USDOT number (digits) or an SMS /SMS/Carrier/{dot}/ URL.

violations.description: Conspicuity Systems - Trailers, side retro reflective sheeting inadequate on vehicle manufactured on or after December 1, 1993
Air Brake - Fails air loss rate test
Brake - Audible air leak from a brake chamber
Lighting - Turn signal - Any inoperative on the rearmost vehicle.
Lighting - Stop lamps - Both inoperative when required to be on
Emergency Equipment - Fire Extinguishers - no fire extinguisher present or not properly rated.
Air Brake - ABS malfunction lamp defective on truck-tractor manufactured on or after March 1, 2001 for towed vehicle.
Air Brake - ABS malfunction lamp defective on truck-tractor manufactured on or after March 1, 1997 and each single unit CMV on or after 1998.
State/Local Laws - Speeding 11-14 miles per hour over the speed limit
Air Brake - Fails air loss rate test
Brake - Audible air leak from a brake chamber
Air Brake - ABS malfunction lamp defective on trailers manufactured on or after March 1, 1998
Air Brake - ABS malfunction lamp defective on truck-tractor manufactured on or after March 1, 1997 and each single unit CMV on or after 1998.
State/Local Laws - Speeding 6-10 miles per hour over the speed limit
State/Local Laws - Speeding 6-10 miles per hour over the speed limit
State/Local Laws - Failed to obey a traffic control device - Permanent or Temporary - e.g., safety official, signal, sign, light, lane marking, other

200.description:
SMS per-carrier export (ai.fmcsa.dot.gov/SMS/Carrier/{dot}/Download.aspx, XML): every roadside inspection of the 24-month record with its vehicles and violations, every reportable crash with its vehicle, and serious violations, optionally restricted to one BASIC. The site exports everything at once (several MB for large fleets); this function pages the records client-side, 50 per call, inspections first, then crashes, then serious violations, with totals of each and the export's snapshot date.

The response contains the tool result directly.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

name.description: Text contained in the carrier's legal or DBA name (case-insensitive; the site adds its own wildcards).

200.description:
SAFER carrier name search (keywordx.asp): every carrier whose legal or DBA name contains the text, with its USDOT number, city/state and Company Snapshot URL. The site returns at most 500 matches and has no paging; `truncated` is true (and coverage partial) when that cap was hit, so narrow the name. A name that matches nothing is a successful empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `city` | string |  |
| `location` | string | `CITY, ST` as listed. |
| `name` | string | The legal or DBA name that matched, as listed. |
| `snapshot_url` | string |  |
| `state` | string |  |
| `usdot_number` | string |  |

post.description:
You want a listing with fleet size and safety totals per carrier, or more than SAFER's 500-match cap allows, and want to page through it.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's meta.page.next_cursor (`<page>:<total>`); omit for page 1.

query.description: Carrier name text (contains match) or a USDOT number.

200.description:
SMS carrier search (ai.fmcsa.dot.gov/SMS/Search): carriers whose name contains the query, 50 per page with the total count, each with USDOT number, legal and DBA names, operation, country, service center, state, county, city, passenger/hazmat/new-entrant flags, power units, total inspections and total crashes (24 months). Page 1 is the search form's POST; later pages are the site's SimpleSearchResults fragment, reached with the returned continuation cursor. A query that is a bare USDOT number is resolved by the site to that one carrier. A query that matches nothing is a successful empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `city` | string |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `county` | string |  |
| `dba_name` | string |  |

| `legal_name` | string |  |
| `new_entrant` | boolean |  |
| `operation` | string | e.g. `Interstate Non-HMSP`, `Intrastate Non-HM and Non-HMSP`. |
